_source: OpenCode v1.18.31 (commit 014614d), from its OpenAPI (GET /doc of an `opencode serve` run in throwaway directories, nothing signed in): GET /question (operationId question.list) answers QuestionRequest[] across sessions, each {id, sessionID, questions: QuestionInfo[], tool?: {messageID, callID}}, QuestionInfo {question, header, options: [{label, description}], multiple?, custom?}; POST /question/{requestID}/reply takes {answers: string[][]}, one list of labels per question, and answers true. Source: packages/opencode/src/question/index.ts, packages/schema/src/v1/question.ts, packages/opencode/src/server/routes/instance/httpapi/groups/question.ts. The turn waits until the question is replied or rejected; a reply from the API closes the TUI's dialog (packages/tui/src/context/sync.tsx). Values are synthetic.
